page.overview:
What is Adventure RWQFSFASXC?

, shortened to Adventure RXQ and commonly referred to as Adventure Shadow Bonnie, is an unlockable character in FNaF World.

RWQFSFASXC's appearance is almost identical to his counterpart from the core series but he is slightly smaller and his teeth are different. RWQFSFASXC is nothing more than a silhouetted Shadow version of Adventure Toy Bonnie with glowing white eyes and teeth.

RWQFSFASXC is a very good support character to have in any party. Even though he cannot do any direct damage his Gift Boxes ability can revive fallen allies and his Mimic Ball can copy Attacks, including Gift Boxes. His Haunting Ability can temporarily freeze an enemy giving the player's party an advantage, especially on some bosses that attacks fast like Supergoon.

When using RWQFSFASXC, the player should use Gift Boxes at the start of a battle (the Auto:Gift Boxes chip is also recommended). After Gift Boxes is used, Mimic Ball can be used to double every attack and can help stack Gift Boxes. Use Gift Boxes again if a party member has fallen and use Mimic Ball again if it's gone. With Mimic Ball and Gift Boxes already set, the player can then use Haunting to temporarily freeze enemies, giving the player's party an advantage.
